title: Fourier expansion of the discrete derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. At every point $x$ of the cube, the discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$ is $\displaystyle \sum_{S\subseteq[n]:\,i\in S}\widehat f(S)\,\chi_{S\setminus\{i\}}(x)$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ and $\chi_T$ is the sign monomial indexed by $T$.
